axiom_worldedit_gui.status.starting: WorldEdit is still starting. Try again in a moment
axiom_worldedit_gui.status.no_player: The player is not in the world yet
axiom_worldedit_gui.status.journal_broke: Could not reach Axiom's undo history. WorldEdit edits use //undo until the game restarts
axiom_worldedit_gui.selection.none: No Axiom selection. Region commands use WorldEdit's own selection
axiom_worldedit_gui.selection.shape: Selection: shape in a %s box, %s blocks
axiom_worldedit_gui.selection.shape_fixe: This Axiom selection has a free shape and cannot be expanded or contracted. Use a box selection
axiom_worldedit_gui.selection.too_big_fo: The new selection is too large to show its exact shape, so Axiom shows its bounding box
axiom_worldedit_gui.commands.filter: Search by name, alias or description
axiom_worldedit_gui.pattern.active_block: Add Axiom's active block to the mix. You can also drag a block from the hotbar, Inventory, Active Block or Palette onto a block below or onto +. Right-click a block for its properties.
axiom_worldedit_gui.pattern.complex: Not a plain list of blocks (tags, #clipboard, random states...): edit it as text.
axiom_worldedit_gui.form.slider_tooltip: Ctrl+click to type any value. Right-click to reset to the default.
axiom_worldedit_gui.form.fill_or_clear: Fill in %s, or clear the fields after it
axiom_worldedit_gui.console.we_undo.tool: Runs //undo. Use it for edits marked 'in WorldEdit history'. Other edits are undone with Ctrl+Z
axiom_worldedit_gui.console.journal_togg: On: WorldEdit edits go to Axiom's history, so Ctrl+Z and the History window undo them. Off: use //undo
axiom_worldedit_gui.console.empty: Results of commands sent from the addon appear here
axiom_worldedit_gui.console.input_hint: Type a WorldEdit command, e.g. //set stone, and press Enter
axiom_worldedit_gui.console.journal.axio: In Axiom history, %s blocks. Ctrl+Z undoes it
axiom_worldedit_gui.console.journal.worl: Changed entities or biomes, so it stays in WorldEdit history. Use WorldEdit undo
axiom_worldedit_gui.menu.hide_cui: Hide WorldEditCUI lines in the editor
axiom_worldedit_gui.menu.brush_carry: Keep shape and radius when switching brushes
axiom_worldedit_gui.mask.from_axiom.tool: Take the mask set in Axiom's Tool Masks window and write it in WorldEdit syntax
axiom_worldedit_gui.mask.axiom_empty: No mask is set in Axiom's Tool Masks window
axiom_worldedit_gui.mask.axiom_unsupport: WorldEdit has no equivalent for this part of the Axiom mask: %s
axiom_worldedit_gui.brush.not_configured: Pick a brush and fill in its settings; they apply by themselves
axiom_worldedit_gui.brush.how_to: Hold the right mouse button to paint. Ctrl + middle mouse drag changes the radius. One stroke is one step in the undo history (Ctrl+Z).
axiom_worldedit_gui.clipboard.to_worlded: Copy Axiom's clipboard into WorldEdit's, for //paste, //rotate, //stack or the clipboard brush. It is centred on you when pasted
axiom_worldedit_gui.clipboard.to_axiom.t: Copy WorldEdit's clipboard (with //rotate and //flip applied) into Axiom's, to place it with Axiom
axiom_worldedit_gui.clipboard.axiom_empt: Axiom's clipboard is empty. Copy something with Ctrl+C first
axiom_worldedit_gui.clipboard.worldedit_: WorldEdit's clipboard is empty. Use //copy first
axiom_worldedit_gui.shape.title: Turn the selection box into:
axiom_worldedit_gui.shape.box.tooltip: Box turns any shape back into its bounding box
axiom_worldedit_gui.shape.done: Done. The new shape is the Axiom selection now
axiom_worldedit_gui.files.no_schematics: No schematics yet. Save the WorldEdit clipboard below
axiom_worldedit_gui.files.load.tooltip: Load into WorldEdit's clipboard (then //paste, or the clipboard brush)
axiom_worldedit_gui.files.load_axiom.too: Load into WorldEdit's clipboard and copy it to Axiom's, to place it with Axiom
axiom_worldedit_gui.expr.help: Coordinates x, y, z run from -1 to 1 across the selection (with -r they are world coordinates, with -o relative to the placement, with -c relative to the centre). Operators: + - * / % ^, comparisons < <= > >= == !=, && || !. Functions: sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sqrt cbrt abs floor ceil round min max exp ln log10, random() randint(a,b), perlin(seed,x,y,z,freq,octaves,persistence), voronoi(seed,x,y,z,freq), ridgedmulti(seed,x,y,z,freq,octaves), query(x,y,z,type,data). Several statements are separated by ; and //deform assigns new x, y, z.
axiom_worldedit_gui.files.load_timeout: WorldEdit did not finish loading the schematic in time
axiom_worldedit_gui.brush.radius_limit: WorldEdit allows brushes up to radius %s (max-brush-radius in its configuration)
axiom_worldedit_gui.brush.limit_raised: WorldEdit's brush limit is now %s (written to %s)
axiom_worldedit_gui.brush.mode.plain.too: The brush itself, on its own shape
axiom_worldedit_gui.brush.mode.apply.too: Apply to every block of the chosen shape
axiom_worldedit_gui.brush.mode.paint.too: Apply to random blocks of the chosen shape, as dense as set
